Author

November 23, 2026

1 Scope

Deaths of residents of the 33 study municipalities during the warm seasons (1 November to 31 March) of 2009 to 2020, from the death records of the Department of Health Statistics and Information (DEIS), and the analytic dataset of the space-time-stratified case-crossover design.

Code/20_mortality_deis.R 
# 20_mortality_deis.R
# Deaths of residents of the study municipalities during the warm seasons of
# 2009-2020, with cause, age and sex groups.
#
# Inputs
#   inputs$deis_deaths   DEIS death records (official open-data file, or an
#                        extract of it with the same columns), semicolon
#                        separated, Latin-1
# Outputs
#   Data/Derived/deaths_clean.csv                 one row per death
#   Output/Tables/mortality_flow.csv              records kept at each step
#   Output/Tables/mortality_excluded_causes.csv   causes outside A00-R99
#   Output/Tables/mortality_by_cause_year.csv
#   Output/Tables/mortality_by_municipality_year.csv
#
# The underlying cause (DIAG1) defines the cause groups of the analysis plan.
# Deaths from injuries and external causes (S00-T98 in DIAG1, with the
# external cause V01-Y98 in DIAG2) fall outside non-accidental mortality
# (A00-R99), and so do the U codes (COVID-19 in 2020). They stay in the file,
# flagged, so that every exclusion can be counted.

source(here::here("Code", "00_setup.R"))
source(here::here("Code", "01_functions.R"))

municipalities <- study_municipalities()
study_years <- get_param("mortality", "years")
warm_months <- get_param("study", "warm_season_months")
cause_groups <- get_param("mortality", "cause_groups")
age_breaks <- unlist(get_param("mortality", "age_breaks"))
age_labels <- unlist(get_param("mortality", "age_labels"))
stopifnot(length(age_labels) == length(age_breaks))

needed <- c("FECHA_DEF", "SEXO_NOMBRE", "EDAD_TIPO", "EDAD_CANT", "COD_COMUNA",
            "DIAG1", "DIAG2", "LUGAR_DEFUNCION")
header <- names(fread(input_path("deis_deaths"), sep = ";", encoding = "Latin-1", nrows = 0))
if (!all(needed %in% header)) {
  stop("Columns missing from the DEIS file: ",
       paste(setdiff(needed, header), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
raw <- fread(input_path("deis_deaths"), sep = ";", encoding = "Latin-1", select = needed)

# ---- 1. Selection, counted step by step -------------------------------------

flow <- list()
count_step <- function(step, dt) {
  flow[[length(flow) + 1]] <<- data.table(step = step, deaths = nrow(dt))
  invisible(dt)
}
deaths <- count_step("Records in the input file", raw)
deaths[, date := as.Date(FECHA_DEF)]
deaths <- count_step("With date of death and municipality of residence",
                     deaths[!is.na(date) & !is.na(COD_COMUNA)])
deaths <- count_step("Residents of the 33 study municipalities",
                     deaths[COD_COMUNA %in% municipalities$code])
deaths <- count_step(sprintf("Died in %d-%d", study_years[1], study_years[2]),
                     deaths[year(date) >= study_years[1] & year(date) <= study_years[2]])
deaths <- count_step("Died in the warm season (1 November to 31 March)",
                     deaths[is_warm_season(date, warm_months)])

# ---- 2. Cause, age and sex --------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(all(grepl("^[A-Z][0-9]{2}[0-9X]$", deaths$DIAG1)))
deaths[, icd10 := DIAG1]
deaths[, icd3 := substr(DIAG1, 1, 3)]
for (group in names(cause_groups)) {
  deaths[, (group) := icd10_in_ranges(icd3, unlist(cause_groups[[group]]))]
}

# Age in completed years; ages recorded in months, days or hours are under one
stopifnot(all(deaths$EDAD_TIPO %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4, NA)))
deaths[, age_years := fcase(EDAD_TIPO == 1, as.numeric(EDAD_CANT),
                            EDAD_TIPO %in% 2:4, 0)]
deaths[, age_group := cut(age_years, c(age_breaks, Inf), labels = age_labels, right = FALSE)]
deaths[, sex := fcase(SEXO_NOMBRE == "Hombre", "male", SEXO_NOMBRE == "Mujer", "female",
                      default = "undetermined")]
deaths[, place := fcase(LUGAR_DEFUNCION == "Casa habitación", "home",
                        LUGAR_DEFUNCION == "Hospital o Clínica", "hospital or clinic",
                        default = "other")]

count_step("Non-accidental cause (A00-R99)", deaths[non_accidental == TRUE])
count_step("Non-accidental, with age and sex recorded",
           deaths[non_accidental == TRUE & !is.na(age_group) & sex != "undetermined"])
flow <- rbindlist(flow)
fwrite(flow, file.path(dir_tables, "mortality_flow.csv"))

excluded <- deaths[non_accidental == FALSE, .(deaths = .N), keyby = .(
  cause = fcase(substr(icd3, 1, 1) %in% c("S", "T"), "Injuries (S00-T98)",
                substr(icd3, 1, 1) == "U", "Codes for special purposes (U), COVID-19",
                default = "Other"),
  year = year(date))]
fwrite(excluded, file.path(dir_tables, "mortality_excluded_causes.csv"))

# ---- 3. Save ----------------------------------------------------------------

deaths <- merge(deaths, municipalities, by.x = "COD_COMUNA", by.y = "code")
setnames(deaths, c("COD_COMUNA", "name"), c("com", "municipality"))
setorder(deaths, date, com, icd10, age_years, sex)
deaths[, id := .I]
deaths[, year := year(date)]
keep <- c("id", "date", "year", "com", "municipality", "sex", "age_years", "age_group",
          "place", "icd10", "icd3", names(cause_groups))
deaths_clean <- deaths[, ..keep]
fwrite(deaths_clean, file.path(dir_derived, "deaths_clean.csv"))

# ---- 4. Summary tables ------------------------------------------------------

by_cause_year <- rbindlist(lapply(names(cause_groups), function(group) {
  deaths_clean[get(group) == TRUE, .(cause = group, deaths = .N), keyby = year]
}))
setcolorder(by_cause_year, c("cause", "year", "deaths"))
fwrite(by_cause_year, file.path(dir_tables, "mortality_by_cause_year.csv"))

non_accidental <- deaths_clean[non_accidental == TRUE]
summarise_by <- function(group_type, group_column) {
  non_accidental[, .(deaths = .N), keyby = c("com", "municipality", "year", group_column)][
    , .(com, municipality, year, group_type = group_type, group = as.character(get(group_column)), deaths)]
}
by_municipality_year <- rbind(
  non_accidental[, .(group_type = "cause", group = "non_accidental", deaths = .N),
                 keyby = .(com, municipality, year)],
  rbindlist(lapply(setdiff(names(cause_groups), "non_accidental"), function(group) {
    deaths_clean[get(group) == TRUE, .(group_type = "cause", group = group, deaths = .N),
                 keyby = .(com, municipality, year)]
  })),
  summarise_by("age_group", "age_group"),
  summarise_by("sex", "sex")
)
fwrite(by_municipality_year, file.path(dir_tables, "mortality_by_municipality_year.csv"))

message("deaths_clean.csv: ", nrow(deaths_clean), " deaths, ",
        sum(deaths_clean$non_accidental), " non-accidental")
print(flow)
Code/21_case_crossover_dataset.R 
# 21_case_crossover_dataset.R
# Analytic dataset of the space-time-stratified case-crossover design.
#
# Inputs
#   Data/Derived/deaths_clean.csv         (script 20)
#   Data/Derived/exposure_2009_2020.csv   (script 13)
# Outputs
#   Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv       one row per death and referent day
#   Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv      exposures at lags 0 to 3 by municipality-day
#   Output/Tables/case_crossover_summary.csv
#
# Each non-accidental death is its own stratum. The referent days are all the
# days of the same municipality, calendar year, month and day of the week:
# the day of death (case = 1) and three or four control days (case = 0).
# Exposures are attached to any model by joining exposure_lagged.csv on the
# municipality and the day: the column <variable>_lag<k> is the exposure k
# days before that day.

source(here::here("Code", "00_setup.R"))
source(here::here("Code", "01_functions.R"))

lags <- unlist(get_param("design", "lags_days"))
stopifnot(identical(unlist(get_param("design", "control_strata")),
                    c("municipality", "year", "month", "day_of_week")))

deaths <- fread(derived_path("deaths_clean.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
deaths[, date := as.Date(date)]
deaths <- deaths[non_accidental == TRUE]

exposure <- fread(derived_path("exposure_2009_2020.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
exposure[, date := as.Date(date)]

# ---- 1. Referent days -------------------------------------------------------

cc <- build_case_crossover(deaths[, .(id, com, date)])
# Every referent day must be a day of the exposure dataset
stopifnot(nrow(fsetdiff(unique(cc[, .(com, date)]), exposure[, .(com, date)])) == 0)

person <- deaths[, !c("com", "date", "year", "municipality", "icd10")]
cc <- merge(cc, person, by = "id")
setorder(cc, id, date)
fwrite(cc, file.path(dir_derived, "case_crossover.csv"))

# ---- 2. Lagged exposures ----------------------------------------------------

exposure_variables <- c(
  grep("^hw_", names(exposure), value = TRUE),
  grep("_gt_p[0-9]+$", names(exposure), value = TRUE),
  "tmax", "tad",
  as.vector(outer(c("o3", "o3obs", "o3mda8", "pm25", "no2", "hum"), c("idw", "ok"),
                  paste, sep = "_"))
)
lagged <- lagged_exposure(exposure, exposure_variables, lags)
# Keep the municipality-days that are a referent day of at least one death
lagged <- lagged[unique(cc[, .(com, date)]), on = .(com, date)]
fwrite(lagged, file.path(dir_derived, "exposure_lagged.csv"))

# ---- 3. Summary -------------------------------------------------------------

controls <- cc[, .(controls = .N - 1L), by = id]
summary_table <- data.table(
  item = c("Deaths (strata)", "Rows (deaths and referent days)",
           "Deaths with 3 control days", "Deaths with 4 control days",
           "Municipality-days used as referent", "Lagged exposure columns"),
  value = c(uniqueN(cc$id), nrow(cc), sum(controls$controls == 3), sum(controls$controls == 4),
            nrow(lagged), ncol(lagged) - 2L)
)
fwrite(summary_table, file.path(dir_tables, "case_crossover_summary.csv"))

message("case_crossover.csv: ", nrow(cc), " rows for ", uniqueN(cc$id), " deaths")
print(summary_table)

2 Source and selection

The input is the official DEIS file of deaths 1990-2023 (open data, one row per death, with date, sex, age, municipality of residence and underlying cause). The scripts read either that file or an extract of it with the same columns; the run behind this page used the extract of residents of the Metropolitan Region who died in 2009-2020.

Show the code 
flow <- read_table("mortality_flow.csv")
kable(flow, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), col.names = c("Step", "Deaths"))
Show the code 
excluded <- read_table("mortality_excluded_causes.csv")
kable(dcast(excluded, cause ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0),
      format.args = list(big.mark = ","))

Non-accidental mortality follows the analysis plan: underlying cause between A00 and R99. Two groups fall outside it. Injuries, coded S00-T98 with their external cause in a second field, are the exclusion the plan asks for. The U codes are COVID-19 (U07.1 and U07.2): 595 deaths in the warm-season months of 2020 are therefore not part of the non-accidental series. Whether the months of the pandemic stay in the analysis is a decision for the principal investigator.

3 records have a recorded age above 110 years; they stay in the oldest age group.

3 Mortality by cause, age and sex

Show the code 
cause_year <- read_table("mortality_by_cause_year.csv")
cause_wide <- dcast(cause_year, cause ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0)
cause_wide[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = setdiff(names(cause_wide), "cause")]
cause_wide <- cause_wide[match(names(cause_labels), cause)]
cause_wide[, cause := cause_labels[cause]]
kable(cause_wide, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
Show the code 
age_sex <- dcast(non_accidental[, .N, by = .(age_group, sex)], age_group ~ sex, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
age_sex[, total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = setdiff(names(age_sex), "age_group")]
age_sex[, share := 100 * total / sum(total)]
kable(age_sex, digits = 1, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
Show the code 
daily <- non_accidental[, .N, by = date]
monthly <- daily[, .(per_day = mean(N)), by = .(year = year(date), month = month(date))]
monthly[, month := factor(month, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 11, 12),
                          labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Nov", "Dec"))]
ggplot(monthly, aes(year, per_day)) +
  geom_line(colour = ramp_blue[6], linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = ramp_blue[6], size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~month, nrow = 1) +

3.1 By municipality

Show the code 
shapes_env <- new.env()
load(input_path("municipality_shapes"), envir = shapes_env)
shapes <- shapes_env$comunas_santiago[, "cod_comuna"]
shapes$com <- as.integer(shapes$cod_comuna)
by_mun <- non_accidental[, .(per_year = .N / 12, oldest = 100 * mean(age_group == "85+", na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = com]
map_values <- function(column, title, legend, hue, digits) {
  ggplot(merge(shapes, by_mun, by = "com")) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[column]]), colour = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_magnitude(name = legend, hue = hue,
                         labels = function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)) +
    labs(title = title) + theme_map()
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(
  map_values("per_year", "Deaths per year", "Deaths", "blue", 0),
  map_values("oldest", "Deaths at ages 85 or more", "%", "orange", 0), ncol = 2
)

mun_year <- read_table("mortality_by_municipality_year.csv")
mun_wide <- dcast(mun_year[group == "non_accidental"], municipality ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0)
kableExtra::scroll_box(
  kableExtra::kable_styling(kable(mun_wide, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ",")),

The same table for every cause group, age group and sex is in Output/Tables/mortality_by_municipality_year.csv. Counts are deaths, not rates: population denominators enter with the attributable burden (deliverable 3).

4 The case-crossover dataset

Each non-accidental death is one stratum. Its referent days are all the days of the same municipality, calendar year, month and day of the week: the day of death and three or four control days. A month is either inside or outside the warm season, so every control day is a warm-season day.

Show the code 
kable(read_table("case_crossover_summary.csv"), format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
      col.names = c("Item", "Value"))
Show the code 
cc <- fread(derived_path("case_crossover.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8", nrows = 9)
kable(cc[, .(id, com, case_date, date, case, sex, age_group, icd3)],
      caption = "First rows of case_crossover.csv: two deaths with their referent days.")

Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv holds the structure and the attributes of each death (sex, age group, cause flags). Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv holds, for every municipality-day used as a referent, each exposure variable at lags 0 to 3 (<variable>_lag<k> is the exposure k days earlier). Joining the two on municipality and day gives the model dataset for any definition:

library(survival)
cc <- fread("Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv")
lagged <- fread("Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv")
model_data <- merge(cc, lagged[, .(com, date, hw = hw_p95_2d_lag1, oz = o3_idw_gt_p75_lag1)],
                    by = c("com", "date"))
clogit(case ~ hw + oz + strata(id), data = model_data)

5 Method checks

tests/test_methods.R checks the functions behind this page and the next against independent calculations: the referent selection, the lagging, the equivalence between the fit on individual records and the faster weighted fit used in the models, the recovery of known odds ratios from simulated deaths, and the delta-method intervals against msm::deltamethod.

Run tests/test_methods.R 
checks <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
                  shQuote(here::here("tests", "test_methods.R")), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
if (!is.null(attr(checks, "status"))) stop(paste(checks, collapse = "\n"))
cat(grep("^ok|^All|simulated", checks, value = TRUE), sep = "\n")
ok   consecutive_flag, n = 2, equals the run-length definition 
ok   consecutive_flag, n = 3, equals the run-length definition 
ok   consecutive_flag, n = 4, equals the run-length definition 
ok   consecutive_flag returns NA when the window holds a missing day 
ok   excess_heat_factor matches the hand calculation 
ok   daily_from_hourly: 24-hour mean and MDA8 of a known day 
ok   daily_from_hourly: a day with 10 valid hours has no 24-hour mean 
ok   icd10_in_ranges: non-accidental A00-R99 
ok   icd10_in_ranges: several ranges 
ok   build_case_crossover: referents share year, month and weekday with the day of death 
ok   build_case_crossover: the Thursdays of January 2015 
ok   lagged_exposure: lag k is the value k days earlier in the same municipality 
ok   additive_interaction: REOI = OR11 - OR10 - OR01 + 1 
ok   additive_interaction: delta-method intervals equal msm::deltamethod 
ok   collapsed weighted fit equals the individual conditional logistic fit (coefficients) 
ok   collapsed weighted fit equals the individual fit (standard errors) 
ok   number of deaths carried by the collapsed fit 
     simulated deaths: 74578  estimates: 1.086, 1.035, 1.296  truth: 1.100, 1.050, 1.300  z: -0.78, -1.37, -0.21 
ok   estimates recover the true odds ratios (within 3 standard errors) 
ok   the REOI interval covers the true value 
All checks passed.

## Scope

Deaths of residents of the 33 study municipalities during the warm seasons
(1 November to 31 March) of 2009 to 2020, from the death records of the
Department of Health Statistics and Information (DEIS), and the analytic
dataset of the space-time-stratified case-crossover design.

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| file: ../Code/20_mortality_deis.R
#| code-summary: "Code/20_mortality_deis.R"
```


## Source and selection

The input is the official DEIS file of deaths 1990-2023 (open data, one row per
death, with date, sex, age, municipality of residence and underlying cause).
The scripts read either that file or an extract of it with the same columns;
the run behind this page used the extract of residents of the Metropolitan
Region who died in 2009-2020.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-flow
#| tbl-cap: "Records kept at each step of the selection."
flow <- read_table("mortality_flow.csv")
kable(flow, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), col.names = c("Step", "Deaths"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-excluded
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths outside non-accidental mortality (A00-R99), by calendar year."
excluded <- read_table("mortality_excluded_causes.csv")
kable(dcast(excluded, cause ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0),
      format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

Non-accidental mortality follows the analysis plan: underlying cause between
A00 and R99. Two groups fall outside it. Injuries, coded S00-T98 with their
external cause in a second field, are the exclusion the plan asks for. The U
codes are COVID-19 (U07.1 and U07.2): `r fmt(excluded[grepl("COVID", cause), sum(deaths)])`
deaths in the warm-season months of 2020 are therefore not part of the
non-accidental series. Whether the months of the pandemic stay in the analysis
is a decision for the principal investigator.

`r fmt(deaths[age_years > 110, .N])` records have a recorded age above 110 years;
they stay in the oldest age group.

## Mortality by cause, age and sex

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cause-year
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths in the warm-season months by cause group and calendar year. The groups overlap: each sub-cause is part of its parent group."
cause_year <- read_table("mortality_by_cause_year.csv")
cause_wide <- dcast(cause_year, cause ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0)
cause_wide[, Total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = setdiff(names(cause_wide), "cause")]
cause_wide <- cause_wide[match(names(cause_labels), cause)]
cause_wide[, cause := cause_labels[cause]]
kable(cause_wide, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-age-sex
#| tbl-cap: "Non-accidental deaths by age group and sex, warm seasons 2009-2020."
age_sex <- dcast(non_accidental[, .N, by = .(age_group, sex)], age_group ~ sex, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
age_sex[, total := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = setdiff(names(age_sex), "age_group")]
age_sex[, share := 100 * total / sum(total)]
kable(age_sex, digits = 1, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-daily
#| fig-cap: "Non-accidental deaths per day in the 33 municipalities by month of the warm season and calendar year."
#| fig-height: 3.8
daily <- non_accidental[, .N, by = date]
monthly <- daily[, .(per_day = mean(N)), by = .(year = year(date), month = month(date))]
monthly[, month := factor(month, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 11, 12),
                          labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Nov", "Dec"))]
ggplot(monthly, aes(year, per_day)) +
  geom_line(colour = ramp_blue[6], linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = ramp_blue[6], size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~month, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2010, 2015, 2020)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Deaths per day")
```

### By municipality

```{r}
#| label: fig-map-deaths
#| fig-cap: "Non-accidental deaths per year in the warm-season months, 2009-2020, and share of deaths at ages 85 or more."
#| fig-height: 4.8
#| fig-width: 9
shapes_env <- new.env()
load(input_path("municipality_shapes"), envir = shapes_env)
shapes <- shapes_env$comunas_santiago[, "cod_comuna"]
shapes$com <- as.integer(shapes$cod_comuna)
by_mun <- non_accidental[, .(per_year = .N / 12, oldest = 100 * mean(age_group == "85+", na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = com]
map_values <- function(column, title, legend, hue, digits) {
  ggplot(merge(shapes, by_mun, by = "com")) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[column]]), colour = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_magnitude(name = legend, hue = hue,
                         labels = function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)) +
    labs(title = title) + theme_map()
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(
  map_values("per_year", "Deaths per year", "Deaths", "blue", 0),
  map_values("oldest", "Deaths at ages 85 or more", "%", "orange", 0), ncol = 2
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-municipality

mun_wide <- dcast(mun_year[group == "non_accidental"], municipality ~ year, value.var = "deaths", fill = 0)
```

The same table for every cause group, age group and sex is in
`Output/Tables/mortality_by_municipality_year.csv`. Counts are deaths, not
rates: population denominators enter with the attributable burden
(deliverable 3).

## The case-crossover dataset

Each non-accidental death is one stratum. Its referent days are all the days of
the same municipality, calendar year, month and day of the week: the day of
death and three or four control days. A month is either inside or outside the
warm season, so every control day is a warm-season day.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cc
#| tbl-cap: "Size of the case-crossover dataset."
kable(read_table("case_crossover_summary.csv"), format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
      col.names = c("Item", "Value"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cc-example
cc <- fread(derived_path("case_crossover.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8", nrows = 9)
kable(cc[, .(id, com, case_date, date, case, sex, age_group, icd3)],
      caption = "First rows of case_crossover.csv: two deaths with their referent days.")
```

`Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv` holds the structure and the attributes of
each death (sex, age group, cause flags). `Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv`
holds, for every municipality-day used as a referent, each exposure variable at
lags 0 to 3 (`<variable>_lag<k>` is the exposure k days earlier). Joining the two
on municipality and day gives the model dataset for any definition:

```r
library(survival)
cc <- fread("Data/Derived/case_crossover.csv")
lagged <- fread("Data/Derived/exposure_lagged.csv")
model_data <- merge(cc, lagged[, .(com, date, hw = hw_p95_2d_lag1, oz = o3_idw_gt_p75_lag1)],
                    by = c("com", "date"))
clogit(case ~ hw + oz + strata(id), data = model_data)
```

## Method checks

`tests/test_methods.R` checks the functions behind this page and the next
against independent calculations: the referent selection, the lagging, the
equivalence between the fit on individual records and the faster weighted fit
used in the models, the recovery of known odds ratios from simulated deaths,
and the delta-method intervals against `msm::deltamethod`.

```{r}
#| label: method-checks
#| code-summary: "Run tests/test_methods.R"
checks <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"),
                  shQuote(here::here("tests", "test_methods.R")), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
if (!is.null(attr(checks, "status"))) stop(paste(checks, collapse = "\n"))
cat(grep("^ok|^All|simulated", checks, value = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```
